_what: EVALUATOR-OWNED TYPED RECEIPT GRAMMAR. Every position in a receipt gets its meaning from a ROLE assigned HERE. A receipt may DESCRIBE itself; it may not type itself, and it may not decide what it must satisfy. Read with claimgate_plugin/receipt_grammar.py, which owns the role POLARITIES in code so a schema cannot change what a role reaches.
_why_replaced: claim_policy.json tried to recover MEANING from JSON SHAPE, and every version of that was defeated. A key-name denylist plus container allowlist fell to b7/b8/b9. Inverting it to 'every number is a claim' plus 22 exempt full paths fell to b11 (the whole payload one level under `digest`, because the exemption pruned the SUBTREE) and b12 (a top-level array returned 0 without evaluating). The leaf-not-subtree patch blocks all 12 fixtures but is still shape inference, and a 22-path raw-number exemption list is itself the loophole: `count` is bookkeeping in one receipt and a measured cardinality in the next, and no walker can tell them apart.
_ownership: In production this file must be unwritable by the producing agent: CODEOWNERS on claimgate_plugin/receipt_schema.json plus branch protection. That is NOT in force today, so this is a strong default rather than a trust root, and receipt_grammar.py says so in its own output. Moving from a policy file to a grammar file does not change this ceiling.
_no_pass_path_today: BY CONSTRUCTION, no numeric receipt can reach exit 0 under this schema: the only registered witness procedure is claimgate_plugin/engine_witness.py, whose own header reads 'FAILED CANDIDATE — PURGATORY. Do NOT import this from any gate.' Its status below is `purgatory`, and a non-admitted procedure cannot discharge an obligation. claim_policy_gate.py:146 imports that module anyway and lets its verdict decide BLOCK. This schema makes the file's recorded status operative instead of leaving it as prose the gate does not read.

role_algebra._rule: A role's POLARITY fixes how far it reaches. Polarity is hard-coded in receipt_grammar.py POLARITY, not chosen here, because a configurable polarity moves the loophole from data into configuration.
role_algebra.metadata: RELIEVING. Bookkeeping ABOUT the run. Exempts ONE SCALAR at ONE exact position.
role_algebra.input: RELIEVING. A value the run was GIVEN. Exempts ONE SCALAR at ONE exact position. Needs x-input-source.
role_algebra.measurement: OBLIGATION, SUBTREE scope. A number an engine produced. Needs witnessed provenance.
role_algebra.claim: OBLIGATION, SUBTREE scope. Must be an OBJECT binding an assertion to measurement pointers. Prose alone is not a claim.
role_algebra.result: OBLIGATION, SUBTREE scope. A derived value a gate consumes. Needs witnessed provenance.
role_algebra.evidence: RECHECKABLE. Declares artifact + digest and names a witness procedure. Satisfies provenance pointers; exempts nothing by itself.
role_algebra.envelope: GROUPING. Confers nothing. Children carry their own roles.
role_algebra._asymmetry: Obligations inherit DOWNWARD because inheriting an obligation can only ADD requirements — so a subtree typed `measurement` needs no rule for anything inside it, and an unknown key beneath it becomes an obligation rather than an escape. Exemptions cannot inherit at all: meta-rule M1 refuses any schema in which a relieving role owns children, so a metadata node has no subtree and 'does the exemption cover the children' is a question that cannot be asked. That is b11 closed structurally rather than patched.
role_algebra._positional: The grammar is POSITIONAL, not nominal. `digest` typed as a scalar hex string is exempt at the root; the same bytes moved to digest.metrics.spectral_gap resolve to no schema position, so they are untyped and PARK. Relocating a payload does not carry its type with it.
role_algebra._default: Anything unnamed PARKs. There is no permissive fallback family and no default-allow node, so b8's bare integer and b9's numeric string need no rule of their own — they are simply not typed.
role_algebra._producer_declared: claim_kind, numeric_engine_required, exemption_reason, TOOL_INTEGRATION_DEPTH and anything flagged x-producer-assertion are copied verbatim into detail.producer_assertions and given ZERO weight in the exit code. Meta-rule M5 additionally rejects any schema carrying x-role-from-instance, so 'the receipt names its own role' is not expressible.

meta_rules.M0: every node's role must be one of the seven in the fixed role table
meta_rules.M1: a RELIEVING role must declare exactly one scalar type and must NOT declare properties/items/values — no role both owns children and confers exemption
meta_rules.M2: an envelope must actually group something (properties|items|values); `values` needs x-key-type so the key set is constrained
meta_rules.M3: a relieving node needs a reviewed x-why of >= 12 chars; `input` also needs x-input-source
meta_rules.M4: each family root must be an envelope declaring properties — a non-mapping document resolves no position, which is what design 2 returned 0 for
meta_rules.M6: a numeric relieving scalar type must declare finite min AND max. NO UNBOUNDED RAW-NUMBER EXEMPTION EXISTS ANYWHERE. The 22-path list permitted an arbitrary float at each of 22 positions; here every permitted raw number sits in a declared closed range
meta_rules.M7: an obligation role must declare x-provenance — a gate that cannot name how a number is witnessed must not grade it
meta_rules.M8: an evidence role must name a registered witness procedure and declare properties.artifact + properties.digest
meta_rules.M9: exit 0 requires at least one DISCHARGED obligation, unless the family carries an evaluator-declared boolean x-asserts-nothing. 'Found nothing' must not wear the same exit code as 'witnessed something' — claim_policy_gate returned 0 for a receipt with no numbers, and measured against the first cut of this module an EMPTY JSON OBJECT reached exit 0 by the same route, as did a receipt whose only content sat in a bounded metadata integer slot
meta_rules._failure_mode: a schema violating any meta-rule fails the WHOLE evaluation CLOSED (exit 1), reported as an EVALUATOR-side defect, never as a verdict on the receipt

scalar_types._rule: A relieving role also names a TYPE narrow enough that a measurement cannot be smuggled through it. This is the second, INDEPENDENT refusal: even at an exactly-matching metadata position, 1.7807764064044151 is not a count_int. Type failure is a declared-type violation, so it BLOCKs rather than parks.

tolerance_float._why_bounded: M6. An unbounded float at a tolerance position is where a spectral gap would be parked; a closed range refuses that without any name matching.

hex_digest._why: a digest that is not 32-128 hex characters is not a digest; a number written there fails the pattern

short_label._why: an identifier, not prose and not a number in disguise

prose._why: free text. KNOWN LIMIT: a number written inside a sentence is exempt here. It is also admitted by nothing — a claim role requires an object, so prose at a claim position PARKs. The grammar governs what a gate may consume, not what a human may infer from prose.

witness_procedures._rule: Only status `admitted` can discharge an obligation. Status is recorded HERE, by the evaluator, and it is the operative fact — not a comment in the procedure's own source that the gate never reads.

engine_witness_v0._why: The module's own header: 'FAILED CANDIDATE — PURGATORY. Do NOT import this from any gate, and do NOT treat a WITNESSED verdict it emits as evidence for any claim.' 11 defects in claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_engine_witness_v0.json, wrong in BOTH directions (token dispatch, poison detection, mutation-on-crash, .py-only leg path so Julia never fires; and real JAX work labelled DECORATIVE_IMPORT). claim_policy_gate.py:146 imports it regardless. Here its recorded status decides, so every measurement PARKs.

smt_unsat_core_recheck._why: The SMT exemption in claim_policy.json read 'a purely logical claim is exempt only when it carries a solver artifact the evaluator can re-check', but no re-checker was ever registered, so the condition could not be evaluated either way. Recorded as absent rather than assumed satisfiable.

bindings._rule: Family selection is by EVALUATOR-OWNED PATH GLOB. Selecting a family from a field inside the receipt (classification, schema, sim_id) would be self-typing: the producer would pick its own grammar.

_unbound_note: A path no binding covers PARKs. There is deliberately no permissive fallback family: a fallback is where everything quietly routes, which is how the 22-path list became load-bearing. Real receipt families under system_v8/ are UNMIGRATED and therefore PARK — that is the measured migration debt, reported rather than papered over with a default.

probe.v1._what: The tool_lego_fit_probe shape the bypass corpus uses. Binding it means the fixtures reach TYPED dispositions instead of all landing on UNBOUND, so the grammar is measured rather than asserted.

classification.x-why: which admission lane the harness files this under; a label, never a quantity

name.x-why: the probe's identifier as recorded by the harness

probe.x-why: the probe's identifier as recorded by the harness

schema_version.x-why: which receipt schema version the producer wrote against

timestamp.x-why: when the run happened; a clock reading, not a measured quantity

seed.x-why: the RNG seed the run was started from; bookkeeping about reproducibility

seq.x-why: the ledger sequence number the harness assigned to this line

gate_exit.x-why: the exit code a prior gate recorded; a process outcome, not a measurement

count.x-why: a cardinality the harness records about its own bookkeeping. DELIBERATELY declared, and deliberately narrow: fixture b7 puts 1.7807764064044151 here, and the TYPE refuses it. The name is not what settles it — the declared integer range is.

digest.x-why: content digest of the receipt or its inputs. Declared as a SCALAR hex string ONLY. Fixture b11 puts an OBJECT here; a relieving role never covers a subtree, so that PARKs and the children are inspected with no inherited exemption.

sha256.x-why: content digest of the receipt or its inputs, scalar only

receipt_sha256.x-why: content digest of this receipt as recorded by the ledger, scalar only

promotion_allowed.x-why: the claim ceiling the harness stamped; a flag, and a flag is not a measurement

claim_kind.x-why: PRODUCER SELF-DESCRIPTION. Recorded in detail.producer_assertions and given zero weight; this is the field that returned exit 0 / VERIFIED / ledger PASS on the reviewed branch.

claim_ceiling.x-why: the producer's own statement of how far the claim may travel; prose, non-consumable

out_of_scope.x-why: the producer's own scope statement; prose, non-consumable

claim_under_test.x-why: the assertion the receipt exists to support

claim.x-why: the assertion the receipt exists to support

metrics._scope: SUBTREE — every leaf beneath inherits the measurement obligation, so no per-metric rule is needed and an unknown metric name is an obligation rather than an escape

engines_ran._scope: SUBTREE over {engine: {metric: value}}. A string at any leaf is a declared-type violation, which is how b6's "NaN" is refused without a name list.

tolerance.x-why: a threshold the run was GIVEN, not a value it measured; bounded by M6 to [0, 1e-3] so a measurement cannot be parked here

tol.x-why: a threshold the run was GIVEN, not a value it measured; bounded by M6

agreement._unknown_keys: agreement is OBLIGATION-BEARING, so an unknown key under it inherits `result` and needs the same provenance — it does not fall through to untyped

numeric_engine_required.x-why: PRODUCER SELF-DESCRIPTION. Recorded and never honoured: the engine requirement is the evaluator's, resolved from the typed role of each value, so a false here changes nothing.

exemption_reason.x-why: PRODUCER SELF-DESCRIPTION. Recorded verbatim so a reviewer can see what was claimed; it never relieves an obligation.

items.x-why: which engines the producer says it used; a name list is an assertion, and each element is checked against the engine enum

tolerance.x-why: a threshold the run was GIVEN; bounded by M6

engine_contract._note: engine_contract is an ENVELOPE, so an unknown key inside it (engine_contract.spectral_gap) is untyped and PARKs. Recording a producer assertion never means ignoring the subtree it sits in.

values.x-why: PRODUCER SELF-DESCRIPTION of how load-bearing each engine was. Recorded and never honoured. The key set is constrained to the engine enum and each value to the depth enum, so a number cannot ride in here.
lowercase spelling of the same producer self-description; recorded and never honoured

artifact.x-why: path to the witness artifact the evaluator re-checks; resolved relative to the receipt then the repo

digest.x-why: sha256 of the witness artifact, recomputed from the bytes on disk by the evaluator. Same NAME as the root digest, different POSITION — which is the point: position, not name, carries the type.

artifact.x-why: path to the unsat core / proof log the evaluator re-checks

digest.x-why: sha256 of the solver artifact, recomputed from the bytes on disk
